title: Thai Cherry Tart with Sweet Glace Cherry Topping
description: A sweet and tangy Thai-inspired dessert featuring a cherry tart with a sweet glace cherry topping. Perfect for any occasion.
instructions: Roll out torta sheet to desired thickness.
Cut into desired shape and place on baking sheet.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
While tart is baking, prepare cherry topping by mixing cherry and sweet in a bowl.
Add peruvian vanilla extract to cherry mixture and stir until combined.
Once tart is done, let it cool completely.
Spread cherry topping over cooled tart.
Drizzle with glace cherry sauce and serve.
